newsitem.title: MEXICO: Banco de Mexico net assets, reserves rise.
newsitem.headline: Banco de Mexico net assets, reserves rise.

text.p: Banco de Mexico said on Tuesday its net international assets as of April 18 were $11.414 billion compared to $10.829 billion on April 11.
The central bank said that its international reserves as of April 18 were $20.903 billion compared to $20.547 billion as of April 11.
The central bank said the increase of $585 million in net international assets in the same time period was due to:
--Net income from operations by the state oil company Pemex worth $394 million.
--The purchase of $150 million from credit institutions, a product of the partial exercising of options on the sale of dollars to the central bank that were issued during the auction of March 31.
--Net sales of foreign currency to the federal government worth $65 million.

--A net loss of $24 million dollars for a combination of factors including changes in the dollar value of non-dollar assets and liabilities held by the bank; net returns on interest rates and from trading of metals and securities; and net deposits in dollar accounts from commercial banks at the central bank.
Banco de Mexico said that between April 11 and April 18 the monetary base rose by 614 million pesos.
In that same week the balance of deposits from the federal government fell by 7.2 billion pesos.

During that time Banco de Mexico sold government securities through repurchases reaching a total of 20.771 billion pesos with the main objective of neutralizing higher liquidity that resulted from lower deposits by commercial banks, development banks and the federal government.

To determine the exact amount of sales of securities through repurchases, Banco de Mexico said it also considered the monetary effect in the variation of international assets, the greater demand for bills and coins and other factors.
The following tables detail Banco de Mexico's reserves, assets and net domestic credit. All figures are in billions of pesos, unless otherwise indicated.
International Reserves
U.S. Dollars $20.547 bln $20.903 bln
Monetary Base 75.130 75.744
Net International Assets*
U.S. Dollars $10.829 bln $11.414 bln
Net Domestic Credit -10,660 -14,131
*Net International Assets are defined as gross international assets minus central bank liabilities with the IMF and assets of less than a six-month duration from other central banks.
((--Dan Trotta, Mexico City newsroom +525 728-9507))
